subject: Seed allowance request for AcuMed co-sell pilot (NimbleCloud SI)
messages:
From: Oliver White <oliver@nimblecloud.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: seed allowance to kick off AcuMed pilot

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the intro and for the quick chat last week. AcuMed (health provider in Boston) is ready to start a 6-week POC with NimbleCloud acting as SI. They’ve asked if we can include Redwood-sourced runway to get them through the initial evaluation (roughly 6–8M tokens).

Quick summary:
- Pilot: 6 weeks, ingest + retrieval-augmented generation for internal triage flows
- Expected usage: peaked at ~100 simultaneous sessions; token burn ~6–8M tokens over pilot
- Outcome: reference implementation + potential committed Dedicated contract if pilot meets SLA

Attached is a short MOA and the high‑level SOW. NimbleCloud is requesting a one‑time seed allowance (partner-sourced credit) to cover the pilot. We’d like to align on the amount and any guardrails (timebox, usage caps, audit tags).

Could you advise who on Redwood can sign off for an SI-sourced onboarding allowance? We’re on a tight timeline — customer wants to start week of May 3.

Thanks,
Oliver White
Head of Partnerships, NimbleCloud
oliver@nimblecloud.io

Attachment: NimbleCloud-MOA.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: Request: seed allowance to kick off AcuMed pilot

Sooj, Vanessa —

Forwarding a request from NimbleCloud (partner SI) for a partner-sourced seed allowance for the AcuMed POC. Key points: pilot starts early May, small but strategic — if successful we expect a mid-six-figure annualized committed spend (Dedicated).

Proposal (initial ask from SI): 8M tokens (equivalent to ~$12k of hosted credits) with the following guardrails:
- Timebox: 6 weeks
- Usage cap: hard limit on tokens at 8M with alerting at 50/75/90%
- Tagging: all pilot traffic must include hubspot.deal=DN-ACU-202704 and partner=nimblecloud
- Billing: credits applied to NimbleCloud-managed billing account; customer must sign SOW

Attachments: Pilot-SOW-draft.docx attached (SOW still needs Docusign). NimbleCloud also sent the MOA.

Can we approve this from the channel/marketplace promotional bucket or do we need finance signoff? If we can approve, please confirm the amount and whether legal wants a short MSA amendment for partner-sourced credits. Customer timeline: kickoff week of May 3.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if helpful.
Alex
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: Pilot-SOW-draft.docx (DOCX, 45KB)

Alex / team —

Thanks for the context. I’m comfortable approving a conditional seed allocation from the Marketplace/Partner Promotions pool under the following conditions:

1) Allocation: 8M tokens (~$12k) issued as a timebound credit on the NimbleCloud billing account
2) Guardrails to be applied in the Console before activation:
   - Hard token cap at 8,000,000 tokens
   - Tag enforcement (hubspot.deal=DN-ACU-202704, partner=nimblecloud)
   - Auto-shutdown if above-expected error rate or if the customer opens a security/compliance escalation
3) Legal/Finance checklist completed (I’ll need a short email confirmation from Finance that credits are accounted for to the Promotions bucket and Legal sign-off on the SOW amendment)
4) Post-pilot deliverable: 1-page pilot summary + usage report (due within 10 business days of pilot end)

If Legal/Finance OK, I’ll route the allocation. I’ve attached allocation-authority.pdf for records. Please get me a signed SOW or at minimum a mutual action plan and the DocuSign link.

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Partner GTM, Redwood Inference
